text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Phew, nice and snug. Perfect!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Ah, Sweep-chan. Checking your horseshoes?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Yes, I just fastened it back on securely!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Huh, that makes me worried~. Here, let me 
see it.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Huh!? H-Hold on a second!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I mean, Sweep-chan, this is your first 
real race, right? I'll pin it back on 
properly for you!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Sweep-chan! I heard you're running in 
your debut race soon! Do you know what 
time you're heading out?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Of course! I just double-checked this 
morning. I even calculated what time I 
need to wake up!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm. Even if you think that the day 
before the race, you'll forget if you 
don't write it down, so be careful. 
Punctuality is key, okay!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Huh? I told you I don't need notes, I can 
remember it just fine—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Sweep, there you are! Fuji told me 
your debut race is coming up.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Are you eating properly? Some girls lose 
their appetite from stress the day before 
a race, you know.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
We're in different dorms, but you're a 
special case. How about I whip up a 
special Hishi Ama boxed lunch for you?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Geez...! I'm fine, I'm eating! I can 
manage myself just fine!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"...My, my, looks like someone's awfully 
irritated. Can't be helped, then."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me! Big sis here's gonna whip 
up something extra special for ya on the 
big day!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: WRRRRRRRRRRROOOONG!!

And on the day of her debut raceâ Sweep 
Tosho actually showed up right on time. 
However...

When I went to pick up Sweep Tosho, Hishi 
Amazon was there, along with... Air 
Groove, the Umamusume known as the 
"Empress."

Hishi Amazon is an Umamusume who won races 
like the Queen Elizabeth II Cup, was once 
hailed alongside the strongest, and 
achieved great results in the Arima Kinen.

Air Groove won the Yushun Himba (Japanese 
Oaks), and then became the first runner 
from the Tiara route in over a decade to 
claim victory in the Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Sweep. Do you have your lunchbox, 
handkerchief, and tissues? You haven't 
forgotten anything, right?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"...I've heard that handkerchief story so 
many times up until today."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Sweep.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Once you arrive at the track, check the 
condition of the turf first. A race begins 
the moment preparation starts.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Moooooore like it, damn it all!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Shut up, I know!! Don't say another word!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Sweep. Everyone was worried about 
you—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
No need to worry at all! I'm gonna take 
1st place easy-peasy!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Bleeeh, so there!! Familiar, let's go!!

And so, accompanied by a sulking Sweep 
Tosho, I somehow managed to reach the 
racetrack, but...

Poking the bear carelessly would only make 
things worse. As I frantically racked my 
brain for a way to cheer her up—
(*Bzzz, bzzz*)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...What is it, Papa?

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Father
text_block_list.text:
Sweep! Ah, thank goodness! You're awake! 
Today's race is—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I did NOT oversleep! See ya!!

“—I've got a bad feeling about today's 
race. I couldn't help but feel that way.”
